Z-Image Turbo模型是由Tongyi-MAI（阿里巴巴人工智能实验室）开发的新发布的（截至2025年11月）高度优化、高效的文本到图像扩散变换器（DiT）模型。它专为闪电般快速的推理而设计，同时在消费级硬件上保持高真实感质量。我已经使这个工作流程面向未来，以便一旦 Z-Image Turbo LORA 发布，它们就可以与此一起使用。我热切地等待 Z-Image Edit，这样我就可以基于此创建更好的工作流程。我简直惊呆了，这速度竟然如此之快！它可以在 8 GB GPU 上在 30 秒内生成近乎完美的 Flux.1，甚至 Flux.2 质量级别图像，无需量化（没有 Q2、Q4 等模型，它是一个非 GGUF 安全张量，大小与任何平均 SDXL 1.0 模型相似）。这是一个非常简单的 ComfyUI 初学者友好的文本到图像工作流程，可与单个 具有多个 LORA 的 Z-Image Turbo 模型（此工作流程需要 ComfyUI 的 LORA Manager 插件才能运行。最好同时安装 ComfyUI 管理器和 LORA Manager 插件，以帮助您轻松下载和管理检查点、LORA 和其他资源。这两个不仅对此工作流程有帮助，而且在任何其他情况下也会为您提供很多帮助）。确保使用 ComfyUI 管理器安装 ComfyUI 所需的插件，并将正确的文件放置在正确的位置。如果您发现此工作流程有用，还可以查看我的 SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0、WAN 2.1、WAN 2.2、QWEN、HiDream、KREA、Chroma、AuraFlow 和 Flux 的其他工作流程。

如何使用这个 -

#1.只需先选择您想要的 Z-Image Turbo 模型，然后加载

#2.从 LORA Manager 启动一个或多个匹配的 LORA

＃3。然后输入您的提示（正面和负面）。

＃4。选择图像尺寸和您想要的图像数量（批次号）

＃5。选择图像采样方法、cfg、步骤等设置

＃6。最后按运行按钮并生成。就是这样..

*** 如果您知道如何正确禁用 LORA 节点并绕过它，此工作流程也将起作用，如果您有疑问，只需使用它，无需任何 LORA 并使用默认设置。

### 要使用此工作流程，您需要登录 Huggingface 并从那里下载必要的文件（我还在包含工作流程文件的存档中包含了一个文本文件，您可以在其中找到更多关于我的其他工作流程的基本下载的链接）-

o.en:
The Z-Image Turbo model is a newly released (as of end of November 2025), highly optimized, and efficient Text-to-Image Diffusion Transformer (DiT) model developed by Tongyi-MAI (Alibaba's AI lab). It is specifically designed for lightning-fast inference while maintaining high photorealistic quality on consumer-grade hardware. I have made this workflow future proof so that as soon as Z-Image Turbo LORAs are released they can be used with this. I am eagerly awaiting for the Z-Image Edit so I can create better workflows based on this. I am simply stunned how fast this is! It can generate near perfect Flux.1, even Flux.2 quality level image in 30 seconds on an 8 GB GPU, with no quantization (no Q2, Q4 etc models, it's a non-GGUF safetensor with size similar to any average SDXL 1.0 model). This is a very simple ComfyUI beginner friendly Text-to-Image workflow that will work with a single Z-Image Turbo model with multiple LORAs (This workflow does require ComfyUI's LORA Manager plugin to function. It is a good idea to install both ComfyUI manager and LORA Manager plugin to help you easily download and manage Checkpoints, LORAs and other resources. Not only these two are helpful for this workflow but they will help you a lot in any other cases). Make sure you install your necessary addons for ComfyUI using ComfyUI manager and place the correct files in correct places. Also check out my other workflows for SD 1.5 + SDXL 1.0, WAN 2.1, WAN 2.2, QWEN, HiDream, KREA, Chroma, AuraFlow and Flux if you find this workflow useful.

How to use this -

#1. Just select your desired Z-Image Turbo model first and then load

#2. one or multiple matching LORA(s) from LORA Manager to start

#3. then input your prompts (positives and negatives).

#4. select image dimensions and how many images you want (batch no)

#5. select image sampling methods, cfg, steps etc. settings

#6. finally press the run button and generate. That's it..

*** This workflow will also function if you know how to properly disable the LORA Node and bypass it, if you are in doubt just use it as it is without any LORA and with default settings.

### To use this workflow you need to log into huggingface and download necessary files from there (I also included a text file on the archive that has the workflow file, in which you will find even more links for essential downloads for my other workflows) -
